tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- EMD Payments through KPP-Portal mode

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Bidder Signed and Scanned copies of valid ISO certifications from competent authority clearly showing validity date in respect of quoted item
Bidder Signed and scanned copy of Income Tax return of the firm or company for the last three financial years i.e. Financial Year.
Bidder Signed and scanned valid copy of Firm/Company Registration/Incorporation Certificate.
List of clients with the copy of the work order for supply & Installation of above sports equipment in Govt. Organization/ PSU/ Academic/ Research Institute/Reputed Organization.

Notary certified declaration that the our firm has neither been blacklisted/no criminal case pending against him attach an affidavit duly notarized on stamp paper worth of Rs.100/- stating that no criminal /Black listing case is pending against the firm by any of the Government Institute/Ministries/ Departments/PSUs with which the firm had contracted Gym equipment during the last five years nor has been penalized by such offices/organizations for supply of poor/spurious Gym equipment.
Technical Specification Compliance/ Deviation If any on Company letter head
The Average Annual Turnover of the Bidder company for participating in this tender must be at least Rs 50 Lakh for any three years of the last three Financial Years

The bidder shall submit signed, attested, and legible scanned copies of satisfactory performance certificates for the supply of similar gym items/equipment to various reputed Government Departments, Institutions, Public Sector Undertakings PSUs, and other reputed institutions in India during the last three financial years, namely.The certificates shall be submitted in chronological order.

The bidder shall visit the proposed site for the installation of outdoor equipment and inspect the site conditions, including the required digging and groundwork. The bidder shall obtain the signature of the authorized officer on the site inspection report and upload the duly signed copy along with the bid documents on the KPPP portal. Failure to submit the signed site inspection report may result in rejection of the bid
The Tenderer should furnish GST Registration Certificate

itemList.itemName: For complete turnkey gym setups and specialized ground works digging in the location and also provide comprehensive services spanning layout design, equipment supply, installation, and heavyduty groundwork like digging for power cages or anchoring functional rigs
